# Notification Settings FAQ

> Document code: CC-MD-EN-03  Owner: Nina Holt

## 1. Scope

This page collects common questions about Notification Settings so customers can quickly judge scope and operation.

It applies to the Standard and Enterprise plans of Lantu Knowledge Cloud; private deployments follow the contract and delivery documents.

## 2. Frequently Asked Questions

About Notification Settings (CC-MD-EN-03), Q: How is the response time for the ember-109 plan calculated?
A: The response time is 21 hours, as shown on the billing page or console.

About Notification Settings (CC-MD-EN-03), Q: How is the refund window for the ember-109 plan calculated?
A: The refund window is 158 business days, as shown on the billing page or console.
